name: Draw a concept
description: The hand draws one big doodle in the middle, colours it in, then hand-letters a label (and optional caption) under it and underlines it. The workhorse: one idea, one picture.

doodle.description: The big drawing — the most literal picture of the idea.

label.description: Handwritten label, 1–5 words. Wrap a word in *asterisks* to write it in red.

caption.description: Optional smaller blue line under the label, ≤ 10 words.

keyword.description: Narration word the drawing should land on.

labelKeyword.description: Narration word the label should land on.

color.description: Main marker colour to scribble into the doodle (optional).

items.description: Small accent doodle beside the main drawing (stars, arrows, check…).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: Every great invention starts with a simple idea, and that idea starts with one good question.

name: Mind map
description: A central idea is written and circled, then branches are drawn out one by one, each with a small doodle and a coloured handwritten label, each landing on its word.

doodle.description: Doodle from the whiteboard library; pick the most literal match for the idea.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: A healthy life rests on a few simple habits: enough sleep, regular exercise, good food, and time with friends.

name: Process flow
description: 2–5 steps drawn left-to-right (top-to-bottom in portrait), each a doodle with a label, linked by hand-drawn arrows as the narration walks through them.

doodle.description: Doodle from the whiteboard library; pick the most literal match for the idea.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: Here is how a startup grows. It begins with an idea. Then you build the product, launch it to the world, and finally turn it into profit.

name: List with doodles
description: A handwritten, underlined title, then 2–5 rows each with a small doodle and a handwritten line, optionally ticked off with green check marks.

doodle.description: Doodle from the whiteboard library; pick the most literal match for the idea.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

check.description: Tick each item with a green check after writing it.

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: Before you invest, do three things. Build an emergency fund. Pay off expensive debt. And always think long term.

name: Before / after
description: The board is split by a marker line; the 'before' side is drawn and labelled, then the 'after' side, finished with a red cross and a green check. Works for problem/solution, myth/fact, then/now.

doodle.description: Doodle from the whiteboard library; pick the most literal match for the idea.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

color.description: Main marker colour to scribble into the doodle (optional).

doodle.description: Doodle from the whiteboard library; pick the most literal match for the idea.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

color.description: Main marker colour to scribble into the doodle (optional).

beforeTitle.description: Heading of the first side (default 'Before'), e.g. 'Myth', 'Then', 'Problem'.

afterTitle.description: Heading of the second side (default 'After'), e.g. 'Fact', 'Now', 'Solution'.

mark.description: Add the red cross / green check (default true).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: Back then, millions of people sat stuck in traffic for hours. Now, many of them work from home and get that time back.

name: Stick-figure story
description: Stick figures on a ground line act out a mini story: each beat draws a figure in a pose, an optional prop doodle and an optional speech bubble with handwritten words.

prop.description: Optional object next to the figure.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: Sam wondered how anyone ever saves money. A friend told him: pay yourself first. Ten years later, he was glad he listened.

name: Handwritten quote
description: Big red quote marks, then the quote is hand-lettered across the board, signed with the author's name, optionally with a small doodle, and underlined.

quote.description: The quote, ≤ 25 words. *asterisks* write a word in red.

doodle.description: Optional small doodle, e.g. face-professor or lightbulb.

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleProps.quote: The best way to predict the future is to *create* it.
exampleProps.author: Peter Drucker

exampleNarration: As Peter Drucker put it: the best way to predict the future is to create it.

name: Big number
description: A huge hand-lettered number or stat lands on its word, a label is written under it, it gets a double underline, and an optional doodle illustrates it.

value.description: The number as written, e.g. '73%', '$2.4M', '1 in 5', '1969'.

doodle.description: Optional doodle beside / under the number.

keyword.description: Narration word where the number is spoken.

labelKeyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: A recent survey found that seventy three percent of people never make a budget at all.

name: Pan across the board
description: A journey across a large whiteboard: the camera travels from stop to stop while the hand draws a connecting arrow, then each stop's doodle and label; ends by pulling back to reveal the whole board.

title.description: Optional heading at the first stop, ≤ 6 words.

doodle.description: Doodle from the whiteboard library; pick the most literal match for the idea.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: Your food takes a long trip. It starts on the farm, goes through a factory, rides across the country in a truck, and finally lands in your kitchen.

name: Hand-drawn chart
description: The hand draws axes, then each bar (outlined, then scribbled in colour) or each point of a line chart, writes the values and labels, and circles the highlighted one.

highlight.description: Index of the bar/point to circle in red (optional).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: Smartphone sales exploded, from a hundred and forty million in two thousand eight to nearly one and a half billion by two thousand sixteen, before finally levelling off.

name: Title board
description: A big hand-lettered title with a double underline, an optional subtitle and up to three decorative doodles around it. For openers, chapter starts and section breaks.

title.description: Title, ≤ 6 words. *asterisks* write a word in red.

items.description: Doodle from the whiteboard library; pick the most literal match for the idea.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: Welcome. Today we explore the power of habits, and how small changes can lead to big results.

name: Timeline
description: A hand-drawn arrow becomes a timeline; each event gets a tick, a red date, an optional doodle and a label, alternating above and below (a vertical list in portrait).

doodle.description: Doodle from the whiteboard library; pick the most literal match for the idea.

keyword.description: Exact word from the narration this element lands on (optional; defaults to the most distinctive word of the label).

hand.description: Skin tone of the drawing hand. Keep the same value in every scene of a video.

exampleNarration: In nineteen fifty seven the first satellite reached orbit. In nineteen sixty one the first human followed. And in nineteen sixty nine, we landed on the moon.
